messages.subject: Spark Summit East
parts:
Hi all,

I have just attended Spark Summit East in NYC! This is my very first Spark summit and I truly enjoyed it. It was super exciting to know that Matei has included SparkR in the future directions in the keynote, and how users and developers are adopting it from different angles. Thanks so much for organizing such a wonderful summit and inviting us to be part of it.

Hao
